fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2BD3D20 allocates 0x40 and zeroes it as a hash map. ProcessRecipeRequests (bg3.exe+0x2BD0DA0 lines ~493-501) walks a request's 4-byte keys (FixedString recipe ids) and inserts each (FUN_140ca9830), then stores a 1-byte value at values[+0x30][index]. The Toolkit version names the type in an assert: IndexedStorage<class ls::HashMap<class ls::FixedString,bool,struct ls::HashTableOpsDefault>. Live (1): buckets 5, 2 keys, values size 2.
